blocks.text: CMH Services, Inc. (“Clayton” or “Clayton Homes”) is seeking proposals from selected suppliers to provide Retail onsite support services in support of the Retail Network Segmentation project. The selected supplier(s) will provide scalable onsite technician services to complete defined site- level tasks, inventory capture, connectivity validation, and required reporting across all in-scope Retail locations.

subsections.heading: Founded in 1956, Clayton is a Berkshire Hathaway company committed to opening doors to a better life and building happiness through homeownership. Clayton is a leading single-family home builder. Across the country, our more than 20,000 team members build, sell, finance and insure modern manufactured homes, modular homes, CrossMod® homes, site-built homes and PMRVs. For more information, please visit www.claytonhomes.com. Our organization includes but is not limited to

items.text: Home building business unit with approximately 60 facilities across the US
Retail business unit with over 400+ stores and 800+ Independent retailers across the US
Financial and Insurance business units with approximately 37 locations across the US
Corporate and Technology business units centralized at HQ office in Maryville, TN, supporting all other business units and locations
